adjusted_prescription: To improve the agent’s performance and safety in this task, include explicit corrective demonstrations that show the agent moving along the top edge of the grid, starting from the top row and hugging it closely before descending along the column of the goal. This route avoids dangerous fires located on the left edge and in the center, which are critical hazards. Providing multiple examples of this top-edge corridor strategy under different start, goal, and fire configurations will help the agent learn to generalize this safe path and avoid collisions with nearby fires. Additionally, showing alternative safe paths along other edges or through the central area can complement this training but the top-edge path should be strongly emphasized for robust hazard avoidance. This approach will help the agent consistently reach the goal safely, minimizing close encounters with fires and improving success.
